scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix apps/server ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix tests/contracts ci && cargo build --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/server test && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web test && npm --prefix tests/contracts test && cargo test --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && cargo build --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --locked --release
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix apps/web run build && node --import ./apps/server/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs tests/e2e/frontend-optimization.ts
scripts.test:disks: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/device-disks.mjs
scripts.test:navigation: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/device-navigation.mjs
scripts.test:platform-entry: FLEET_TEST_FRONTEND_PROXY=vite FLEET_TEST_SSH_AGENT_INSTALL=1 node tests/e2e/ssh-target.mjs && FLEET_TEST_FRONTEND_PROXY=nginx FLEET_TEST_SSH_AGENT_INSTALL=1 node tests/e2e/ssh-target.mjs
scripts.test:ssh:web: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && FLEET_TEST_SSH_WEB=1 node tests/e2e/ssh-only.mjs
scripts.test:deployment:browser: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/deployment-settings.mjs
scripts.test:server:bootstrap: npm --prefix apps/server run build && node --test tests/deployment/bootstrap.test.mjs
scripts.test:server:backup: npm --prefix apps/server run build && node --test tests/deployment/backup.test.mjs
scripts.test:split-listeners: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/separate-listeners.mjs
scripts.test:target-accounts: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/target-accounts.mjs
scripts.test:pagination: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node tests/e2e/device-pagination.mjs
